newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nobel Design Holdings issues 20 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Nobel Design Holdings issues 20 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Nobel Design Holdings Limited issued on Friday 20 million new shares at Singapore $0.33 each in its Initital Public Offer (IPO).
The interior design and furniture group is offering 15 million shares to the public and five million to be placed out to investors.
The company is seeking a listing on the second board SESDAQ. The share price of S$0.33 each works out to a forecast price earning ratio of 10.2 times.

The offer will raise about S$6.0 million in net proceeds which will be used to finance the building of its furniture factory in Woodlands, expanding businesses in Malaysia and China, finance contract projects and as working capital.
For the financial year ending December 31 1996, the group has forecast a turnover of S$39.0 million and net profit after tax of S$2.6 million.
Managing director Bert Choong said Nobel continues to see scope for growth in Singapore.
On its China operations, Choong said: "China is a big market with its own complex ways of doing business. Because of this, we are taking a cautious approach in our investment in China."
Nobel has formed a joint venture in Kunshan, China to make and distribute furniture including kitchen, wardrooms and toilet cubicles. The China plant is expected to start production in 1997.
The offer will close on November 21 and trading will start on November 25.
